headline: Silicon Valley Engineers Scramble to Fix Software Flaws Found by AI
summary: Artificial intelligence tools have uncovered a surge of software flaws in Silicon Valley, prompting software engineers to rush repairs before hackers can exploit them.
why: Vulnerability identification and remediation cycles dictate enterprise cybersecurity spending, software reliability, and technology risk management.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Mass discovery of code vulnerabilities accelerates patching demand but elevates immediate cybersecurity risks.
